newsitem.title: USA: U.S. funds show outflow for 2-day period.
newsitem.headline: U.S. funds show outflow for 2-day period.

text.p: U.S. mutual funds suffered a rise in outflows for the two-day period ended Oct 28 compared to the previous three-day period, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
Funds posted outflows of $141 million compared with $67 million for the three days ended Oct 24, according to the fund tracker.
U.S. stock funds recorded outflows of $89 million versus inflows of $116 million, while international funds had outflows of $52 million versus $183 million.

Aggressive growth funds had outflows of $115 million versus inflows of $88 million, growth and income funds had inflows of $141 million versus $55 million, and growth funds posted outflows of $39 million versus $48 million.
Bond funds had outflows of $158 million versus inflows of $53 million.
Muni funds posted outflows of $188 million versus inflows of $35 million. High yield funds had outflows of $14 million versus inflows of $13 million.
